title: The input stream contains a control code point that is not ASCII whitespace or U+0000 NULL.
summary: Such code points are parsed as-is and usually, where parsing rules don't apply any additional restrictions, make their way into the DOM.

title: The parser finds a numeric character reference that references a control code point that is not ASCII whitespace or is a U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN.
summary: The parser resolves such character references as-is except C1 control references that are replaced according to the numeric character reference end state.
